title: Signed derivations
description: Whether a positive and a negative case for a target claim can be derived from the leaf cases on file under the stated rules, what blocks each, whether a derived case rests on a contested leaf, and the summary of derived cases.

positive_derivable.description: Whether a positive case for the claim follows from the cases on file.

positive_blocked_by.description: What blocks the positive case when it does not follow.

positive_conditional.description: Whether every derivation of the positive case uses a leaf that also has a contrary case.

negative_derivable.description: Whether a negative case for the claim follows from the cases on file.

negative_blocked_by.description: What blocks the negative case when it does not follow.

negative_conditional.description: Whether every derivation of the negative case uses a leaf that also has a contrary case.

case_summary.description: Which signed cases for the claim were derived.
